scope: Reference reproduction parameters, separated into callable entrypoints and registered formal trials
parameter_transcription: JSON records the parsed parameter values. Identity-specific locations and manuscript/migration bookkeeping are omitted; source_file_sha256 refers to the original source-file bytes rather than this JSON serialization.
precedence: Registered domain, GPU, seed, scenario_set and stage epochs override the shared template. Stage-specific warmup/gvo training and collection fields then override common fields. Warmup disables forced repetitions and exploration.
legacy_configuration_filename_semantics: Compatibility filenames do not define the model identity; every listed model configuration pins the same official BF16 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B revision.

training_config_implementation_defaults.scope: Defaults apply only when a parameter is not overridden. They do not replace the explicit formal profile or TaskGRPO top-level parameters.

formal_profile.optimizer_step_semantics: One joint SGD step per complete frozen collection, with separate actor and Q parameter groups. SFT steps depend on the actual effective supervised batches.

task_answer_grpo_semantics.training_object: Task-answer Drafter LoRA; not SpecRSI Policy/Q full-search-controller training
task_answer_grpo_semantics.kl_reference: Pretrained base with all adapters disabled
task_answer_grpo_semantics.group_semantics: Collect group_size independent complete task episodes for one development item; normalize each episode objective by its generated-token count and then group size; backward each episode and perform at most one optimizer step per complete group.
task_answer_grpo_semantics.selection: Evaluate the initial and post-epoch checkpoints on selection; strict improvement replaces the selected checkpoint, ties retain the earlier checkpoint; audit follows selection.
task_answer_grpo_semantics.model_configuration: Frozen BF16 base with rank16/alpha32/dropout0 hybrid-attention Draft LoRA; role heads remain unchanged.
task_answer_grpo_semantics.execution_scope: These are callable configurations; registered parameters are not benchmark measurements or proof of completed TaskGRPO training.
